title: LinTO Audio and Textual Datasets to Train and Evaluate Automatic Speech Recognition in Tunisian Arabic Dialect
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing and evaluating datasets for Automatic Speech Recognition in a specific Arabic dialect. While it includes some religious texts (narratives of prophets) and hate speech data as part of its broad corpus to ensure linguistic diversity, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a component of the research itself.
